decision.title: Hire full-time engineer vs outsource development
decision.description: We need to decide whether to hire a full-time senior engineer or outsource our development work to an agency. The decision impacts our ability to scale and our burn rate.
decision.context: Early-stage startup with limited runway. Critical features needed in 3 months.

scenarios.title: Full-time hire takes too long to onboard
scenarios.description: Hiring process takes 8 weeks, then onboarding takes 4 weeks. By month 3, new hire is only 50% productive. Critical features miss deadline.

scenarios.title: Agency delivers poor quality code
scenarios.description: Outsourced agency prioritizes speed over quality. Code is difficult to maintain, has security vulnerabilities, and requires extensive refactoring.

scenarios.title: Full-time hire is too expensive and increases burn rate
scenarios.description: Salary + benefits + equity costs $180K/year. Burn rate increases 50%. Runway drops from 18 months to 12 months.

rootCauses.description: No hiring pipeline or pre-vetted candidates
Lack of agency vetting process and code review standards

mitigations.strategy: Start recruiting immediately, use contract-to-hire to test fit before full commitment
Require code reviews, set strict quality gates, use reputable agency with references
Consider hybrid: contract dev for immediate needs, hire full-time after next funding round

factors: Limited runway makes wrong choice costly
Hybrid approach may be optimal but wasn't initially considered
